tasks.label: cleanup-generated-files
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Remove-Item -LiteralPath '.\backend\.venv' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -LiteralPath '.\frontend\node_modules' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -LiteralPath '.\frontend\.vite' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -Force -Directory -Filter '__pycache__' | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
